question: Does resolving a reviewer's thread cause that reviewer to re-post it, reply, or approve?
pass: Written 2026-10-22T18:07:40Z, before the window: CodeRabbit neither re-posts, replies, reopens nor approves in the 10 and 30 minutes after its thread is resolved, with no push between. Run again on 2026-10-29 with section 4.2's configuration, the first run (trials/P-25.json) having had none: the canary's main holds .coderabbit.yaml with reviews.auto_approvals.enabled false (canary pull request 68). On canary pull request 69, a person's, CodeRabbit reviewed at 01:45:53Z, after the Maintainer asked it to at 01:43:07Z, its free review having been rate limited: COMMENTED, with three threads. The trial-author App resolved all three by 01:49:04Z. Passed: the reads at once, at +10 and at +30 minutes are the same, CodeRabbit's only review still the one COMMENTED, no new review, comment, reply or re-post, every thread still resolved by the trial-author App. The Maintainer ran the resolve again at about 01:50Z by mistake; it found no thread to resolve and wrote nothing.
